guiding.whyLead: Krushevo is one of the best and most reliable places on the planet to improve your paragliding skills.
guiding.whyBody: The area has hosted World Cups, European Championships, and the 2019 World Championship — with maximum flyable days.
guiding.bullet1: Predictable weather with almost no strong winds
guiding.bullet2: Safe take-offs and landings across the valley
guiding.bullet3: Easy retrieve thanks to villages and road access
guiding.finePrint: Lunch and dinner outside the package are not included. You need valid equipment, insurance with medical repatriation, and a radio. Typical duration: 7 days. Price: 700 € per person (minimum 4 pilots in group) — confirm current season pricing when you book.

tandemOhrid.heroSubtitle: Fly above Galicica: Ohrid Lake on one side, Prespa on the other.
tandemOhrid.intro: If you are staying in Ohrid, a tandem from the mountain near the lake is an unforgettable perspective on the national park. Certified pilots, transport from your hotel (or agreed meeting point), and photos & videos included in the packages below. National park entrance (about 5 €) applies.
tandemOhrid.earlyNote: Shorter flight (about 4–7 minutes), morning window 8–10 AM, medium altitude difference.
tandemOhrid.expNote: About 5–15 minutes, medium altitude difference. Pick-up in Ohrid or meet at Voena plaza.
tandemOhrid.xcNote: Longer flights when conditions allow — large altitude difference.

tandemKrusevo.heroSubtitle: Nature, forests, and valleys — different from city flying. Meckin Kamen is minutes from the town centre.
tandemKrusevo.p1: Have you ever dreamed of flying like a bird? In Krushevo you fly above forests and valleys instead of over urban sprawl. The area known as Meckin Kamen is one of the most visited take-off sites in the region.
tandemKrusevo.p2: From 79 € per person for a typical 10–15 minute flight. In good thermals, your pilot may offer a longer line and landing further down the valley — ground crew will pick you up. Extended option is typically +20 € (confirm on the day).
tandemKrusevo.p3: Wear hiking boots or supportive shoes and sunglasses; we provide the rest. You can bring a lunch pack or join the team for a meal if everyone agrees.
tandemKrusevo.alert: After you submit a reservation, please also reach us on WhatsApp / Viber so we can confirm weather and time.

faq.sectionLead: Quick answers about tandem flights and XC guiding in Macedonia.

items.q: Where can I fly tandem in Macedonia?
items.a: We offer tandem paragliding from Galicica above Ohrid Lake and from Meckin Kamen near Krushevo — two of the country’s best-known flying sites with lake, mountain, and valley views.

items.q: Do I need experience for a tandem flight?
items.a: No. You fly with a certified tandem pilot who controls the wing. You receive a short briefing before take-off.
We fly only in suitable weather, use inspected equipment, and work with experienced instructors. Tandem passengers should follow the pilot’s instructions and declare relevant health conditions.

items.q: What is XC guiding in Krushevo?
items.a: XC guiding is coaching for licensed pilots who want longer cross-country flights. Krushevo offers reliable conditions, briefings, retrieve, and debriefs — ideal for improving technique.

items.q: How do I book or check accommodation dates?
items.a: Use the calendar to select check-in and check-out, send a request, and the operator will confirm by email. Confirmed stays appear as booked on the calendar.
Most guests use Skopje International Airport (SKP). Transfers from Ohrid or Thessaloniki can often be arranged — mention your plans in the contact form.
